ru: В Singapore Exam Hall каждый абзац начинается с позиции — I would argue, it appears that — но без I think в каждой строке. Альтаир ценит точность, не повтор.
en: In Singapore Exam Hall every paragraph opens with a stance — I would argue, it appears that — but not I think in every line. Altair values precision, not repetition.
es: En Singapore: I would argue, it appears that — sin I think en cada línea. Altair valora precisión.
de: In Singapore: I would argue, it appears that — nicht I think in jeder Zeile.
